application_credentials.description: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from {developers_url}. Your own Boliq login is still needed to choose your bollards in the next step.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Boliq again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer reach your bollards. This happens if you disconnected it in Connected apps on boliq.co.uk. Sign in again to choose your bollards.

abort.already_configured: These bollards are already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Boliq. Try again in a moment.
abort.no_devices: No bollards were chosen, or their monthly plan is paused.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Boliq account from the one set up here.
abort.missing_credentials: Add the Client ID and Client Secret Boliq gave you first.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out making the sign in address.
abort.no_url_available: No address is available. Check how Home Assistant is reached.
abort.oauth_error: Boliq's sign in answered with something unexpected.
abort.oauth_failed: The sign in did not finish.
abort.oauth_timeout: The sign in took too long.
